description: Update the body of an existing SWSD incident comment. Pass `incident_id`, `comment_id`, and the new `body`. The is_private flag cannot be changed by this tool — to change visibility, delete and re-create. WRITE — does not retry on transient failure.

body.description: New comment text (replaces existing). Plain text or HTML.

incident_id.description: SWSD incident reference. Accepts either the internal id (>=7 digits, e.g. 180457930) or the human-facing number (<=6 digits, e.g. 60310). The handler auto-detects via digit count.

name: swsd_update_comment
